_doc: Declared release sources — 12 §1.1, §5.1, F11. Every emitted connect-src entry is derived from this file plus the artifacts it names; nothing is added to the policy by hand. See app/tools/release/README.md.
_phase_gate: Pre-genesis. The bootnode program has no seated operators, no production chain spec exists, and no ar.io gateway fallback set has been chosen — so the emitted connect-src is 'none' and `release:check --production` refuses this tree. Each empty section below is a named readiness blocker, not a default.

chainIdentity._doc: INV-FE-11's pin set (10 §5.4, 02 §8). These are the only chain-shaped values legitimately compiled into the bundle: they are used to *verify* the chain, not to parameterise it. A null is a readiness blocker, never a default — a bundle that shipped a null genesis pin would run `verifyChainIdentity` against nothing and report `verified`.
chainIdentity._paraId_gate: 02 §8: assigned at onboarding; test fixtures use 4242. A fixture value must never ship as a release pin.
chainIdentity._hash_gate: Pre-genesis. No production chain exists, so no genesis hash and no production chain spec exist to hash. deploy/chain-specs/out/ currently holds dev/local specs only.

signing._doc: 12 §1.4's release-signature floor: at least two valid signatures from distinct active keys of the current keyring generation. Declared here so a release cannot be assembled against a keyring that could never satisfy the floor.
signing._gate: No key ceremony has been held (12 §2.1). Key architecture, ceremony and the signer registry are F13.

_providers_note: 10 §8.1 — strictly opt-in, empty by default. An entry here is a host the shipped bundle may reach; it is not a provider the app uses unless the vetted provider registry also lists it.
_rpc_note: 10 §4.5 — the optional WS-RPC fallback. Release-listed only: meta-CSP is fixed at build time, so a user-supplied endpoint outside this list cannot be reached (12 §5.1's accepted cost).
_vendor_rule: D-21, 12 §5.1: an external-tool vendor host MUST NOT appear in any section of this file. The handoff transports are files, the clipboard and the share sheet — none of which is a fetch — and the vendor list ships inside the signed release rather than being fetched.
